summary: Defense Minister Katz warned that an Iranian attack on Israel would trigger strikes on all Iranian infrastructure including energy facilities, stating Israel would 'return Iran to the Stone Age.' Israeli forces killed two Palestinians who crossed the Yellow Line into northern Gaza, and one Palestinian was killed by an airstrike on Al-Thawra Street in Gaza City. US strikes on Iran continued, with reports identifying IRGC missile commander Sardar Jafar Kahrizi killed in Kermanshah and three Iranian pilots killed in recent attacks.
key_points: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz warned that if Iran attacks, Israel will strike all Iranian infrastructure including energy, stating they will 'return Iran to the Stone Age.' (Source: @manniefabian/59088)
IDF killed two Palestinians who crossed the Yellow Line in northern Gaza after they approached forces and posed an immediate threat. (Source: @almogboker78/18123)
Reports identify IRGC senior missile commander Sardar Jafar Kahrizi killed in a US strike on Kermanshah two nights prior. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80264)
Three Iranian Air Force and Navy pilots were identified as killed in recent US attacks: Mojtaba Bagheri, Hamed Okati, and Hossein Mahdavian. (Source: @kianmeli1/91482)
Prime Minister Netanyahu stated Israel is convinced of its ability to remove the threat from Iran and topple the regime. (Source: @inon_yttach/10013)
One Palestinian was killed and several injured in an Israeli strike targeting civilians on Al-Thawra Street, west of Gaza City. (Source: @presstv/205388)
An Israeli settler, 19, was arrested on suspicion of participating in Saturday's attack on Qusra in the northern West Bank. (Source: @manniefabian/59086)
Kuwait reported ongoing missile and drone attacks at 0135Z according to the Kuwait Army General Headquarters. (Source: @shin_persian/9433)

points: Reports identified IRGC senior missile commander Sardar Jafar Kahrizi as killed in a US strike on Kermanshah two nights prior, described as the 'assassination' of a senior missile commander. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80264)

Three Iranian military pilots were identified as killed in recent US attacks: Mojtaba Bagheri and Hamed Okati from the Navy, and Hossein Mahdavian from the Army Air Force. The exact circumstances of their deaths during the attack remain unclear. (Source: @kianmeli1/91482)

Trump posted that the renewed US campaign against Iran 'will not last much longer,' claiming the US stopped Iran from building sea-mining rockets. He also asserted the US has practically unlimited munitions stockpiled. (Source: @asafroz/53020)
Press TV reported from Bushehr that the region has experienced relative calm following intense IRGC retaliatory strikes against American targets. (Source: @presstv/205385)

Iranian Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref warned that 'dark months' await the US economy and urged Americans to stockpile fuel and gasoline, claiming US 'crimes' have changed Iran's defense doctrine to 'unbalanced' and 'multi-layered' tactics. (Source: @VahidOnline/78216)

Defense Minister Israel Katz warned that if Iran attacks Israel, the military will target all regime infrastructure including energy, stating Israel would 'return Iran to the Stone Age and darkness.' Katz cited signs of heavy economic pressure on Iran and fears of uprising as potential drivers of desperate measures. (Source: @manniefabian/59088)

Prime Minister Netanyahu told i24NEWS that Israel has not yet completed the mission against Iran and that all systems are operating to overthrow the regime, expressing confidence in Israel's ability to remove the threat permanently. (Source: @New_security8200/203579)

Israeli forces in southern command are deployed in the Gaza area in accordance with the agreement and will continue to act to remove any immediate threat, as stated following the Yellow Line incidents. (Source: @almogboker78/18123)

IDF troops killed two Palestinians who crossed the 'Yellow Line' in northern Gaza after they approached forces in a manner posing an immediate threat. An additional Palestinian who crossed the Yellow Line was killed in an earlier airstrike. (Source: @manniefabian/59089)
One Palestinian was killed and several others injured following an Israeli strike that targeted civilians on Al-Thawra Street, west of Gaza City. (Source: @presstv/205388)
A serious chest injury was reported for a child in the Qatar camp east of the Hamad area, north of Khan Younis. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388623)

An Israeli settler, 19, from a northern West Bank settlement was arrested on suspicion of participating in Saturday's attack on Qusra village, where dozens of settlers raided the village, occupied a home with a family inside, and attacked residents. He is the first arrest over the incident. (Source: @manniefabian/59086)

Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich stated Israel will have to wage a war in the West Bank to disarm Arabs there, leaving weapons only in the hands of the State of Israel. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388611)
Reports indicated warplanes returning to fly over the south at very low altitude. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388613)
An enemy aircraft reportedly threw explosive materials at the Ali al-Taher grove. (Source: @redlinkleb/40542)
An enemy aircraft dropped a sound bomb at the outskirts of Hadatha towards Aita al-Jabal. (Source: @redlinkleb/40541)
Artillery shelling was reported at Beit Lif. (Source: @redlinkleb/40537)
Israeli warplanes were reported active over the south and eastern sector. (Source: @redlinkleb/40534)

Reports stated the Israeli army established a checkpoint on the road between the villages of Jamla and Sison in the western countryside of Daraa, Syria, conducting thorough inspections of all passing vehicles. (Source: @SharghDaily/181682)
US envoy Tom Barrack reportedly thanked the Jolani government for Syria being an alternative to the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388610)
56 human rights organizations sent a letter to Congress stating that defense integration with Israel is very dangerous and should be removed from the defense bill. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388616)
Iraq reported oil exports rising to 2.340 million barrels per day, equivalent to 71% of oil exports before the strait closure. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89312)
Kuwait reported ongoing missile and drone attacks at 0135Z according to the Kuwait Army General Headquarters, marking active combat operations in the country. (Source: @shin_persian/9433)

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level is highly elevated with active military operations across multiple theaters. Defense Minister Katz's explicit threat to target Iranian energy infrastructure signals potential escalation toward total economic warfare. The reported killing of an IRGC senior missile commander in Kermanshah represents a significant escalation in targeted operations against Iranian military leadership. Ongoing missile and drone attacks on Kuwait indicate the conflict has expanded to Gulf states, creating multi-front pressure on Iranian-aligned forces.
sections.regional_response: Regional responses reflect fragmented positions. US envoy Tom Barrack's reported thanks to the Jolani government for Syria serving as an alternative to the Strait of Hormuz suggests diplomatic coordination on containment strategies. Iraq reported oil exports at 71% of pre-closure levels, indicating economic adaptation to strait disruptions. However, 56 human rights organizations urged Congress to remove defense integration with Israel from the defense bill, signaling international pressure against the military cooperation framework.
sections.intelligence_notes: The pattern of reported Iranian military casualties—including a missile commander and three pilots—suggests US strikes are targeting Iranian military leadership and air defense capabilities. Netanyahu's explicit statements about overthrowing the Iranian regime, combined with Katz's threats of total infrastructure destruction, indicate Israeli policy has shifted from containment to potential regime-change objectives. The West Bank settler violence and subsequent arrest, alongside Smotrich's calls for disarmament operations, point to potential escalation in the Palestinian territories alongside the Gaza operations.
